📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text.
  2. Stats update automatically.
  3. Review counts, times and the top-10 words.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are reading and speaking times calculated?

Reading time assumes 200 words per minute; speaking time assumes 130 words per minute.

What is in the frequency table?

The table lists the 10 most common words with counts and percentages, ignoring case.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No — every stat is computed locally in your browser; nothing leaves your device.
